answer: Press **Shift-Enter** in the Page Picker. It creates or opens a page with exactly the name you typed, while plain Enter may open an existing page with a similar name.

[1] Guide/My First Markdown Page.md (Creating a page)
  - In the Page Picker, pressing Shift-Enter creates a page with exactly the typed name, while pressing Enter may open an existing page with a similar name.
  Creating a page: In the page picker input box type `Photo Walk`, then press **Shift-Enter** to create a page with exactly that name. If your space already contains other pages that match “photo walk” in their name, they may appear here too and hitting **Enter** would open that old page rather than create a new page, pressing **Shift-Enter** ensures you create a new page. / It’s time to start typing. Enter the following markdown (or copy and paste it): / ```markdown / Sam Rivera is planning a photo walk on 2026-06-14.
[2] Page Picker.md (Result ordering)
  Result ordering: When no filter phrase is entered, pages are ordered by their latest activity in descending order. For each page, the picker uses whichever is newer: the last time it was opened on this client or its last modified date. / When entering a filter phrase, the best matches should appear closer to the top, however the second option will always be an option to create a new page with _exactly_ the page name entered as the filter phrase.
  - When a filter phrase is entered, the best matches appear closer to the top, and the second option is always an option to create a new page with exactly the page name entered as the filter phrase.
  Use the page picker to find a note by name or create one in a writable space. For searching inside notes, use [[Search]]. The published documentation is read-only: use your own space for the creation steps below. / The page picker has  ...
[3] Guide/Knowledge Base.md (Create topic pages)
  Create topic pages: Start with subjects you want to return to. In the [[Page Picker]] (**Cmd-k / Ctrl-k**), type a title and press **Shift-Enter** to open that exact name. Write enough context that the page makes sense when opened directly. / Keep each page focused enough that its name is useful in a sentence. You can start at the top level and add folders later. [[Guide/Best Practices]] describes the tradeoffs.
[4] View.md (Widgets and views)
  Using a panel: * `Shift-Enter` creates whatever you typed, in views that allow it. A create row also appears on its own: second in a list, pinned below the tree in a tree. / * The **first character typed into an empty box can route**: / * `^` narrows the page picker to [[Meta Page|meta pages]]. / * `$` opens the anchor picker / * `#` the tag picker / * In the page picker, `Space` on an empty phrase inserts the folder you are currently in, and `Alt-Space` extends the phrase by one more path segment of the best match. A `#tag` anywhere in the phrase filters by tag rather than matching names. / In a tree that supports it: drag a row onto a folder to move it (renaming through SilverBullet’s own machinery, so backlinks follow).
